title: Battery Test and Equipment
seoDescription: Battery cell, module and pack test solutions from Chroma: regenerative charge and discharge systems, battery pack simulators and BMS test systems.

props.title: Battery Test and Equipment
paragraphs: Chroma's battery test portfolio covers the full path from cell to pack: regenerative charge and discharge systems for cells, modules and packs, battery pack simulators, and BMS test systems.
Regenerative designs return discharge energy to the grid, with driving profile simulation and hardware / software integration that can be customised to the test setup.
